name: mod-manager
description: A /mod-manager side pane: every installed mod and plugin with update, auto-update, uninstall, enable/disable, reload and open actions, a background check that flags outdated mods, and adding marketplaces from a GitHub or GitLab URL

check_on_start.title: Check for updates on start
check_on_start.description: Look for mod updates in the background a few seconds after a session starts, and show the count in the status line

check_interval_hours.title: Re-check every (hours)
check_interval_hours.description: How often to look for updates again while a session stays open. 0 turns the periodic check off

show_status.title: Show updates in the status line
show_status.description: Show 'N mod updates' under the prompt when an installed mod has a newer version

auto_update.title: Auto-update all mods
auto_update.description: Update every marketplace mod as soon as a check finds a newer version. A mod's own setting (t in the pane) overrides this

auto_reload.title: Reload after auto-update
auto_reload.description: Run /reload-plugins (once the session is idle) after an auto-update, so the new versions load right away

auto_open.title: Open on start
auto_open.description: Open the pane when a session starts (it appears once the terminal is wide enough)
